name: RSI
description: This keyword returns the RSI of any period of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the RSI of any period of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword.

![Example](./images/img-1632219453.png)

The above keyword will return the previous day RSI 14 value of ACC.

RSI keyword needs at least 2 as an input in period, RSI with period 1 won't work.

The RSI provides technical traders with signals about bullish and bearish price momentum, and it is often plotted beneath the graph of an asset’s price.

Read more about RSI here - https://www.investopedia.com/terms/r/rsi.asp
